blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型的有力指导将取样集中在有条件分发的高密度模式上,将独立取样的噪声矢量倒向几乎相同的视觉原型上。 这限制了那些需要分布宽度的任务的效用,最关键的是合成数据增强. 然而,多样性是整个批次的一个集体财产:一个集可以保持每一个对等相距,但仍会倒塌到一个低维子空间上. 现存的平时噪声优化和回击等总和只能对这种更高级的故障作出微弱的反应. 我们提出DetNO(定点噪声优化),它以RKHS体积在初始噪声上最大化,在一步步的Tweedie预测中将RBF Gramma矩阵的日志决定力最大化,从而形成多样的生成. 此设置级功能等同平方批量;当批量最倒塌并随着多样性的实现而自适应时,其反作用最强. 基于锚地的忠诚度术语使最优化的噪声接近可能存在的区域,而拉格朗日放松则给出了一个双时目标,一个单一的超参数美元,用于管理多样性质量的取舍,而无需经过培训或采样者修改。 跨越了三个主干(SD1.5,SDXL,SD3),DetNO在"VendiScore"和"Mean自相仿"中实现了领先的批内多样性,下游的"几发分级"实验证实,更广泛的模式覆盖为低发分制中合成数据增强带来了统计学上显著的精度提高. 修复管道,只改变分批量目标,基于溴化阻燃剂的聚合物都优于InfoNCE,而日志决定剂在两个基准上都达到最佳下游准确度。 随着批量的增加,其相对于InfoNCE的多样性优势会扩大. 代码见https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) [ 12 ] has become the standard mechanism for steering text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models [ 11 , 27 , 24 ] toward high-fidelity, prompt-aligned images.
Strong CFG, however, concentrates sampling toward the high-density peak of the conditional distribution, collapsing its effective support onto a narrow region of the image manifold (Fig. 1 ).
Under deterministic samplers such as DDIM [ 26 ] , the initial noise fully determines the final image, yet independent noise draws collapse onto the same narrow visual mode.
Multiple images generated from the same prompt converge to nearly identical visual prototypes.
The collapse limits utility in applications that depend on distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation, where near-duplicate outputs provide diminishing returns for downstream model training [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
Classifer-Free Directory (CFG) [12] 已经成为将文本到图像(T2I)传播模型 [11,27,24] 向高真实度,即时相通图像方向引导的标准机制.
然而,强大的CFG将取样集中在有条件分布的高密度峰值,使其有效支持崩溃到图像多面的狭窄区域(图1)。
在像 DDIM [26] 这样的决定性采样器下,初始噪声完全决定了最终的图像,而独立的噪声则拖倒了同样的狭义视觉模式.
由同一种即时生成的多幅相片会汇合到几乎相同的视觉原型.
崩溃限制了依赖于分布宽度的应用程序的实用性,最关键的是合成数据增能,在这种应用中,接近重复的输出为下游模型培训提供了不断减少的回报[9].

blocks.en:
Recovering this diversity requires treating a batch as a whole, since diversity is a collective property of the set rather than a sum over its pairs.
A batch can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace, a higher-order failure mode to which independent pair contributions respond only weakly.
Existing approaches meet this criterion only partially.
Methods that intervene during denoising repel intermediate latents [ 3 , 14 ] or manipulate text embeddings [ 31 ] , paying a per-step cost that scales with trajectory length.
Contrastive Noise Optimization (CNO) [ 13 ] instead optimizes the initial noise with an InfoNCE loss in the Tweedie prediction space, intervening before denoising begins, where the noise largely determines semantic structure [ 8 , 2 ] .
Despite their differing entry points, all build their diversity signal from sum-of-pairwise repulsion, whose gradient remains confined to the span of pairwise directions and can miss higher-order redundancy.
blocks.zh:
恢复这种多样性需要将一个批次作为一个整体处理,因为多样性是一组的集体财产,而不是一对一的总和。
一个批次可以保存每个对等距离,但仍会倒塌到一个低维子空间上,这种更高等的故障模式,独立对等贡献只微弱的响应.
现有办法仅部分符合这一标准。
在消除中间潜伏物[3,14]或操纵文本嵌入[31]时进行干预的方法,按步算成本,按轨距计算。
相對噪音优化 (CNO) [13]取而代之的是将初始噪声与Tweedie预测空间的InfoNCE损失最优化,在去诺开始前进行干预,其中噪声主要决定了语义结构 [8,2].
尽管切入点不同,但都从相和反推来建立其多样性信号,其梯度仍被限制在双相相向的间距上,并可能错失更相等的冗余.

blocks.en:
This motivates a single scalar measuring the collective volume a batch occupies, penalizing redundancy at every order up to B B simultaneously.
We realize this scalar as the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions, making all-order diversity differentiable.
We further show that this objective is self-regulating: repulsion amplifies when the batch is most redundant and relaxes as diversity is achieved, an adaptation that an unweighted sum-of-pairwise objective lacks in the same analysis.
blocks.zh:
这促使一个单一的标尺来测量一个批量所占据的集体体积,同时惩罚每个顺序到B级的冗余.
我们意识到这个标尺是一个RBF Gramma矩阵的日志定型, 它通过一个步骤的Twedie预测, 使得所有顺序的多样性是不同的。
我们进一步表明,这一目标是自我调节的:在批量最冗余时,反感会放大并随着多样性的实现而放松,这种不加权的悲观总和目标在同一分析中缺乏的适应.

We propose DetNO ( Det erminant N oise O ptimization), illustrated in Fig. 2 , which pairs this log-determinant diversity term with an anchor-based fidelity term via Lagrangian relaxation.
A single hyperparameter λ \lambda controls the diversity-quality trade-off, with no training or sampler modification.

A controlled toy experiment shows faithful recovery of all modes where pairwise methods distort mode structure, and downstream few-shot classification produces accuracy gains over both standard sampling and CNO, reaching statistical significance in the low-shot regime ( p < 0.01 p{<}0.01 ).

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We recast diverse T2I generation as a set-level rather than pairwise problem: constrained RKHS volume maximization on initial noise. The objective pairs a log-determinant diversity term with an anchor-based fidelity term, controlled by a single hyperparameter λ \lambda , with no sampler modification. • We show that the log-determinant amplifies repulsion when the batch is most redundant and relaxes as diversity is achieved, a self-regulating property of the Gram matrix eigenspectrum that an unweighted sum-of-pairwise objective lacks in the same analysis. • We validate across three backbone-sampler configurations, demonstrating consistent diversity gains with a controllable quality-diversity trade-off and statistically significant downstream improvements in few-shot classification.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Recovering Mode Diversity in Diffusion Models.
blocks.zh: 2.1 恢复扩散模式的多样性。

blocks.en:
Prior methods recover the limited diversity of conditional diffusion models through repulsion, differing mainly in where they apply it but sharing a diversity signal that decomposes into a sum of pairwise interactions.
One line intervenes during denoising: SPELL [ 14 ] adds sparse repellency terms to the reverse SDE, Particle Guidance (PG) [ 3 ] repels intermediate latents via a joint-particle potential, and DiversityPrompt [ 31 ] optimizes a token embedding online to steer generation toward low-density regions.
All incur per-step overhead that scales with trajectory length.
Contrastive Noise Optimization (CNO) [ 13 ] instead shifts repulsion to the initial noise, optimizing latents via InfoNCE in the Tweedie prediction space before sampling begins.
Both, however, quantify diversity as a sum over sample pairs, so their repulsion never leaves the span of pairwise directions and responds only weakly to higher-order redundancy that collapses the batch onto a low-dimensional subspace.
A separate line targets rare modes of the unconditional or class-conditional distribution via classifier guidance [ 25 , 29 ] , self-guided sampling [ 30 ] , or modified noise schedules [ 28 ] .
Our goal instead is to recover suppressed modes of a text-conditional distribution under strong guidance for a fixed prompt.
blocks.zh:
先前的方法通过回推来恢复有条件扩散模型的有限多样性,主要在应用时有所不同,但共享一个能分解成对相相互作用的总和的多样性信号.
一行在去诺时干预:SPELL [14] 在反向 SDE 中添加了稀有的驱出词; 粒子指导 (PG) [3] 通过联合粒子潜力来击退中间潜出物; 多样性 Prompt [31] 优化了在线嵌入物以引导生成向低密度区域.
所有费用都按走道长度计算。
反相噪声优化(CNO) [13] 转而将反相转向初始噪声,在采样开始前通过Tweedie预测空间的InfoNCE来优化潜在.
然而,两者都将多样性量化为比对样本的总和,因此它们的反向力从不会离开对等方向的跨度,并且只能对使批量倒塌到一个低维子空间的高序冗余反应弱.
单独的一行通过分级制导[25,29],自导取样[30],或经修改的噪声表[28],针对罕见的无条件或类条件分布模式.
相反,我们的目标是恢复在严格指导下固定的文本有条件分配的被压制模式。

blocks.en: 2.2 Initial Noise Optimization in Diffusion Models.
blocks.zh: 2.2 传播模型中的初步噪声优化。

blocks.en:
InitNO [ 8 ] steers noise toward valid regions via attention-based scores for better text adherence, while [ 2 ] learn a mapping to optimal noise configurations to characterize CFG behavior.
Neither addresses diversity.
CNO [ 13 ] establishes that optimizing the initial noise alone can recover suppressed modes, using a pairwise contrastive objective.
We inherit this noise-space pipeline from CNO; what changes is the structure of the diversity signal, from a sum over pairs to log-determinant maximization, a set-level functional equal to the squared RKHS volume that penalizes redundancy at every order.
This objective is jointly optimized with an anchor-based fidelity term under a single hyperparameter λ \lambda .
The log-determinant as a diversity criterion originates in GDPP [ 4 ] , which regularizes a GAN’s generator with a DPP kernel.
We instead apply it as an inference-time objective on the Tweedie predictions of a frozen diffusion model, requiring no training and no DPP sampling.
blocks.zh:
InitNO [8] 通过基于注意力的分数将噪音引导到有效的区域,以更好地坚持文本,而 [2] 学习一个映射到最佳噪声配置来描述CFG行为.
两者都不涉及多样性。
CNO [13] 规定,仅优化初始噪声就可以恢复被抑制的模式,使用对等对比目标.
我们继承了来自CNO的这个噪声空间管道; 多样性信号的结构有什么变化, 从一对对的和数到对数决定最大化, 一个设置级功能等于平方的 RKHS 容积, 在每个顺序上惩罚冗余。
这个目标与一个基于锚的忠诚术语在单高参数 QQ\lambda 下共同优化.
作为多样性标准的对数决定来源于GDPP[4],它用DPP内核规范GAN的生成器.
我们把它用作Twedie对冷冻扩散模型的预测的推论时间目标,不需要培训和DPP取样。

blocks.en: 4.1 Constrained Diversity Maximization on Initial Noise

blocks.en:
Given a batch of initial latent codes Z T = { z T i } i = 1 B ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , I ) Z_{T}=\{z_{T}^{i}\}_{i=1}^{B}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},I) , we compute one-step Tweedie predictions { z ^ 0 | T i } i = 1 B \{\hat{z}_{0|T}^{i}\}_{i=1}^{B} via Eq. 1 .
Even at the initial timestep T T , these predictions capture meaningful semantic structure such as global layout, dominant colors, and object placement [ 2 ] .
Since deterministic samplers such as DDIM [ 26 ] define a fixed mapping from initial noise to final image, diversifying Tweedie predictions at t = T t{=}T propagates through the entire generation path without per-step intervention.
Our goal is to optimize Z T Z_{T} so that these predictions are maximally diverse while remaining in plausible regions of the data distribution.
We formalize diversity through RKHS volume maximization and fidelity through an anchor-based displacement constraint, then combine them via Lagrangian relaxation into a single objective.

blocks.en:
As motivated in Sec. 1 , we quantify diversity as the volume a batch collectively occupies, a set-level functional that penalizes redundancy at every order simultaneously.
An unweighted pairwise sum, by contrast, yields a gradient confined to the span of pairwise directions.
Realizing this in the Tweedie prediction space requires care: the raw prediction z ^ 0 | T i ∈ ℝ C × H × W \hat{z}_{0|T}^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W} suffers from norm concentration, where pairwise distances between independent samples converge to a common value [ 1 ] .
This drives the RBF kernel toward a constant, flattening the very volume signal we maximize.
Predictions at t = T t{=}T primarily encode coarse semantic layout rather than fine spatial detail [ 2 ] .
We therefore suppress high-frequency variance via adaptive average pooling with window w w , then project onto the unit hypersphere: z ~ 0 | T i = AvgPool ⁡ ( z ^ 0 | T i , w ) , z ¯ 0 | T i = z ~ 0 | T i / ‖ z ~ 0 | T i ‖ 2 , \tilde{z}_{0|T}^{i}=\mathrm{AvgPool}(\hat{z}_{0|T}^{i},\;w),\qquad\bar{z}_{0|T}^{i}=\tilde{z}_{0|T}^{i}\big/\|\tilde{z}_{0|T}^{i}\|_{2}, (3) producing compact representations z ¯ 0 | T i ∈ ℝ C ​ w 2 \bar{z}_{0|T}^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{Cw^{2}} on which kernel similarities reflect semantic structure rather than high-frequency noise.
We build the similarity matrix S ∈ ℝ B × B S\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times B} from the RBF kernel, a universal kernel whose Gram matrix is positive semidefinite, so log det ( S + ϵ I ) \log\det(S+\epsilon I) is always well-defined: S i ​ j = exp ⁡ ( − ‖ z ¯ 0 | T i − z ¯ 0 | T j ‖ 2 2 ​ σ 2 ) , S i ​ i = 1 , S_{ij}=\exp\!\left(-\frac{\|\bar{z}_{0|T}^{i}-\bar{z}_{0|T}^{j}\|^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}\right),\quad S_{ii}=1, (4) with bandwidth σ \sigma fixed once from the reference predictions via the median heuristic [ 7 ] : σ = median ⁡ ( { ‖ z ¯ 0 | T i , ref − z ¯ 0 | T j , ref ‖ 2 } i < j ) . \sigma=\operatorname{median}\!\left(\left\{\|\bar{z}_{0|T}^{i,\mathrm{ref}}-\bar{z}_{0|T}^{j,\mathrm{ref}}\|_{2}\right\}_{i<j}\right). We evaluate on three pre-trained T2I backbones: SD1.5 [ 24 ] , SDXL [ 22 ] , and SD3 [ 5 ] .
SD1.5 and SDXL use DDIM [ 26 ] with 50 steps, while SD3 uses the Euler sampler with 28 steps following its default configuration.
We compare against PG [ 3 ] , SPELL [ 14 ] , DiversityPrompt [ 31 ] , and CNO [ 13 ] .
We evaluate all methods under identical conditions (prompt set, random seeds, CFG scale, and hardware) to ensure fair relative comparison; absolute values may differ from original papers accordingly.
We use the official implementations of all baselines, including CNO, with the hyperparameters reported in their original papers.
Following [ 31 , 13 ] , we sample 2,000 prompts from the MS-COCO [ 18 ] validation set and generate 5 images per prompt for SD1.5 and SD3, and 3 images per prompt for SDXL.

Only the log-determinant preserves the full mode structure in a controlled setting, a 2D ring mixture with 8 inner modes (80%) and 8 outer modes (20%) ( Fig. 3 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented DetNO, an initial-noise optimization framework that maximizes the RKHS volume among Tweedie predictions via a log-determinant diversity term and an anchor-based fidelity term.

Experiments on SD1.5, SDXL, and SD3 confirm consistent diversity gains across backbones and samplers, with Pareto analysis showing that λ \lambda enables smooth interpolation between the two objectives.
A toy experiment and a spectral analysis ( Proposition 1 ) trace this advantage to its mechanism: repulsion that intensifies where the batch is most collapsed and relaxes once diversity is restored.
In downstream few-shot classification, the broader mode coverage translates into statistically significant accuracy gains in the low-data regime.
Treating diversity as a property of the whole batch, rather than of its pairs, thus produces image sets that are not only more varied but measurably more useful.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了DetNO,这是一个初始-噪声优化框架,通过一个日志决定多样性术语和一个基于锚的忠诚术语,在Tweedie预测中将RKHS的体积最大化。

关于SD1.5,SDXL,和SD3的实验证实了各骨干和采样器之间一致的多样性增益,而Pareto分析显示,\\ lambda可以使两个目标之间平滑地插入.
一个玩具实验和一个光谱分析(Proposition 1 )将这一优势追溯到它的机理:可增强批量最坍塌地的反冲力,一旦恢复多样性就会放松.
在下游的几发分类中,更广泛的模式覆盖范围转化为低数据制度中统计学上显著的准确性提高.
将多样性视为整个批次的财产,而不是其成对的财产,因此,生成的图像集不仅更加多变,而且明显有用。

Tab. S5 compares the computational cost across methods.
Following CNO, we apply a stop-gradient operator on the UNet output when computing Tweedie predictions, which eliminates the need to retain UNet activations during backpropagation.

The marginal time overhead relative to CNO (17.8 s vs. 17.7 s) stems solely from the Gram matrix computation and its matrix inversion, both of which are negligible compared to the UNet forward passes.

blocks.en: 0.A.8 Effect of Gradient Computation Strategy.
blocks.zh: 0.A.8 渐进计算战略的效果。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table S6 , stop-gradient already yields clear diversity gains over the baseline (MSS, VendiScore) at a marginal quality cost.
Full gradient achieves moderately stronger gains (particularly in Recall and VendiScore) by propagating richer second-order information through the denoising network, but at the cost of storing all intermediate UNet activations during backpropagation.
Stop-gradient closes most of this gap while reducing peak memory to the level of standard inference ( Tab. S5 ), making it the more practical default; we adopt it in Algorithm 1 and note that full gradient can be used when memory budget permits.
blocks.zh:
如表S6所显示,停止升级已经以微薄的质量成本在基线(MSS, VendiScore)上产生明显的多样性增益。
完全梯度通过去诺氏网络传播更丰富的二等信息,但以在回放过程中储存所有中间UNet活化量为代价,从而实现中度更强的收益(特别是在Recall和VendiScore).
stop-radient 关闭了这一缺口的大部分,同时将峰值内存缩小到标准推论的水平(Tab. S5),使它成为更实际的默认;我们在算法 1 中采用它,并注意到当内存预算允许时可以使用全梯度.

blocks.en: 0.A.9 Ablation on Noise Scale
blocks.zh: 0.A.9 噪音规模

blocks.en:
To validate that the diversity gains of DetNO cannot be replicated by simply scaling the initial noise variance, we evaluate 𝐳 T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , s 2 ​ 𝐈 ) \mathbf{z}_{T}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},s^{2}\mathbf{I}) across a range of scale values s s on SD1.5.
As shown in Tab. S7 , any deviation from the standard s = 1 s=1 causes severe image degradation across all quality metrics.
At s = 0.5 s=0.5 , Recall collapses to 0.0002 0.0002 and ImageReward drops to − 2.28 -2.28 , indicating that the denoiser operates far outside its training distribution and produces degenerate outputs. Increasing the scale to s ≥ 1.2 s\geq 1.2 yields similarly catastrophic failures: Recall falls below 0.04 0.04 , CLIPScore drops by more than 8 8 points, and ImageReward becomes strongly negative across all configurations.
This behavior is expected: diffusion model denoisers are trained exclusively with s = 1 s=1 , and any perturbation to the noise scale pushes the initial latent out of the distribution seen during training, causing the reverse process to produce corrupted images regardless of the direction of the scale change.
These results confirm that noise scale manipulation is not a viable mechanism for diversity enhancement, and that the diversity gains of DetNO arise from structured optimization within the valid noise distribution rather than from distributional shift.
